sentences: A police vehicle arrives in an open parking lot and parks near a stationary white sedan.
Two officers step out and approach the suspect vehicle, commanding the occupants to remain inside.
The officers escort the suspect to the patrol car and secure the scene.
A dark alleyway at night with closed commercial rear exit doors.
A person wearing a dark hooded jacket attempts to pry open a metal security latch with a prybar.
The person slips through the forced doorway and enters the closed building.
Two individuals argue heatedly on a street sidewalk near parked cars.
A physical altercation breaks out with shoving and striking as onlookers intervene.
Pedestrians walk casually along an outdoor pedestrian plaza in broad daylight.
Bicycles and normal foot traffic proceed without interruption along the public square.
